provenance: Dedicated native Canvas2D geometry and software3D cube mesh rasterization, an independently authored WebGL smooth-union liquid shader, seeded projected orbit/particle fields, segmented clock/tunnel rings and independently drawn typography. No reference images, screens, full-frame sequences or video loaded by runtime. Original soundtrack is comparison material. OFL ArchivoBlack and Geist font substitutes. Motion/design chunky glyphs are separately authored vector paths, including single-storey g.
editable: project.json43 actual chronology parts, colors, seed, tile patterns, terrain camera keys and particle count;composition.js all explicit geometry, glyph masks and scene trajectories
differences: Motion/design lowercase glyphs are individually authored vector paths; silhouette is closer, but exact counters, motion weight interpolation and falling letter choreography remain approximate.
ArchivoBlack and Geist are OFL substitutes; original changing variable letter contours, blur, ragdoll positions and reveal easing differ.

Cube terrain is an actual independently projected mesh with face shading, shadow layers and ripple heights; original raytraced material, bevels, ambient occlusion, camera and exact tile distribution are not recovered.
Liquid is an independently authored signed-distance shader with seven smooth-union circles; original3Dmetaball geometry, specular material and neck separation differ.
Particle positions, spiral phase, streak curves, density and camera are deterministic authored approximations, not recovered original simulation.
Graphic grid motifs, clock weights, rolling digit phase, recursive ring radii and end-slate spring timing differ from original.
Full451-frame15.033333second picture stream is represented;15.104second audio tail is cut to picture duration. Original audio is source-attributed comparison material.

Actual paired comparison:5.625second cube floor is brighter/flatter, the white wave is narrower and asymmetric, egg material and camera roll differ.6.75second close terrain distribution and hard contact shadows remain visibly different.

7.125second liquid is six symmetric capsules connected to a center; source has asymmetric bulging lobes and detached droplets. The shader reconstructs the causal connect/separate sequence but shape/material need further refinement.
8.50second vortex is close in inner-hole size but source streaks have stronger3Ddepth, bloom, curvature and upward perspective; candidate is an independent projected field.
10.375second ring tunnel radius is corrected but spacing, per-ring colors, blur and zoom pulse phase remain approximate; end slate is about25pixels shifted and font weight is different.
